decision_note.question: Can the old repeated-codeword obstruction be applied to successive whole-cover-word columns?
decision_note.smallest_work: A direct set-membership proof and one complete source-free countermodel; reuse old primary decisions, no manuscript or new historical scan.
decision_note.consequence: Retain a concrete column-overlap obligation instead of falsely importing the disjoint-pool exclusion. This does not bind actual source tables or open native scoring.
decision_note.budget: 03:25–03:35UTC11October2026 for proof, small independent check, documentation and publication; preceding bounded selection read existing sources only.

hypothetical_contract: A fixed finite cyclic sequence of columns C_j, known starting phase, advances once per encoded source character.
Each column maps each source character injectively to one complete visible packet. Tables may share packet spellings across columns.
One emitted packet per step, no nulls/skips/resets within the window. These are hypothetical local premises, not asserted as the fullBookIhistorical rule.

necessary_condition.formula: A repeated whole packet w for r steps requires w in intersection(C_(j+t) for t=0..r-1), with indices modulo the fixed period.
necessary_condition.unknown_phase: If the start phase is unknown, at least one phase j must satisfy the entire intersection. Do not fit a different arbitrary phase per token.
necessary_condition.consequence: Pairwise-disjoint consecutive column inventories cannot produce even ww; a triple needs one packet shared by three consecutive phase positions. Phase values can repeat if the period is1or2.
necessary_condition.not_implied: The rdecoded source characters need not be equal: the same packet can encode different characters in different columns.

countermodel.source_domain: All finite strings over four abstract source symbols; the supplied initial phase and finite message framing are shared. This is a mathematical countermodel, not a historical or Voynich writer.
countermodel.writer: For source position i, emit the table entry for that source symbol in column(initial_phase+i)mod3. Separate whole packets visibly.
countermodel.reader: At each position invert that column. Every column is bijective, so the complete source is recovered.

decision: Before a repetition test on a concrete table-clock channel, bind actual complete column inventories, packet boundaries and advance/reset conventions, then check the stated intersection condition. Do not count native triples again or run a periodic decoder from this note. This is a method-scope result, not new manuscript evidence or an unchanged missing-input census.
